item.title: ADO AO Nissan StadiumConcert 2026
item.description:
First Day in Shinjuku, Tokyo (Pre-Ado Concert) / 10日目 - 東京・新宿初日（Adoライブ前日）

Finally, the day I’ve been waiting for!

ついに、待ちに待った日がやってきました！

I woke up around 8:00 AM, and since checkout was at 10:00 AM, I got straight to organizing my luggage. Carrying a massive suitcase with me all the way from Osaka to Tokyo would have been a complete pain in the back. Thankfully, my hotel offered luggage forwarding! I went down to the lobby around 9:30 AM, and the staff member there was super friendly and helpful. I provided him with my next hotel details, and the total cost for forwarding was around ¥2,000.

item.title: AdoVerse Map
item.description:
Ohayo! It’s been a while since I’ve written a blog post. I wanted to share an update on a project I’ve been working on for the past few months.

If you’ve never heard of her, Ado is a Japanese singer and Utaite (a singer who performs covers and original songs online). I’ve been a huge fan since she performed the songs for the One Piece Film: Red movie, where she provided the singing voice for Uta (Shanks’ daughter). Ever since then, I’ve been following her journey. She has never revealed her face. I actually hope she keeps her identity a secret…you never know how the public might react, and it adds to her unique mystique.
